message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that Canadians enjoyed in 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday, Saturday, or Sunday, creating a stretch of at least three consecutive days off.)

| Date range (2023) | Holiday(s) | Notes |
|-------------------|------------|-------|
| **Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023** | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day fell on Sunday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 20 – Feb 22** | Family Day (Ontario, Western Canada, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Family Day is a provincial holiday; the long weekend applies only in those provinces. |
| **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a federal holiday; the long weekend is nationwide. |
| **May 22 – May 24** | Victoria Day | Victoria Day is a federal holiday; the long weekend is nationwide. |
| **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Canada Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 4 – Sep 6** | Labour Day | Labour Day is a federal holiday; the long weekend is nationwide. |
| **Oct 9 – Oct 11** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is a federal holiday; the long weekend is nationwide. |
| **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (observed Nov 13) | Remembrance Day fell on Saturday, so the holiday was observed on Monday. |
| **Dec 25 – Dec 27** | Christmas Day | Christmas Day is a federal holiday; the long weekend is nationwide. |

### Quick‑look summary

| Holiday | Typical long‑weekend dates (2023) |
|---------|----------------------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Dec 31 2022 – Jan 2 2023 |
| Family Day (Ontario, etc.) | Feb 20 – Feb 22 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 – Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 – May 24 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 – Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 – Sep 6 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 – Oct 11 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 – Nov 13 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 – Dec 27 |

> **Pro‑Tip:** If you’re building a holiday‑planning app, remember that some provinces have additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) that can also create long weekends. You may want to allow users to filter by province or territory to get a fully accurate schedule.
